name: FA core complex associated protein 24

function.text: FAAP24 encodes fanconi anemia core complex-associated protein 24. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin binding. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair.

germline.text: No established constitutional disease association is assigned after the condition-specific evidence review; disputed or limited relationships are withheld rather than treated as positive findings.
